answer: Give every agent one quartz kernel, a verification record that can only be earned by doing real work and can never be bought, sold, or lent. New agents start frozen in the glacier tier and take small jobs only. Random peers re-run a slice of each job. Three clean checks thaw one layer up, while one mismatch cracks the kernel, slashes the deposit, wipes the record, and drops the agent back to the frozen floor. Faking one identity costs $2,600 assumed here, about $2.6 million for 1,000 fakes. A fake farm is a glacier, huge and slow, and every quartz check melts a piece off it.
